732750101.text: ♪ ... Ah. It's you. Come, come. These flowers are growing well, are they not?

732750102.text: The Golden Roses have sprouted into seedlings, yes.

732750103.text: These seeds... Where did you even find these seeds, I wonder?

732750105.text: Did you indeed? Well, I suppose that the seeds Uncle Shafaqat sowed really did find their way back here in the end after being spread to every corner of the desert — even if the path they took meandered quite a bit.

732750107.text: We'll have to take good care of these seedlings — I intend to leave them to young Sabbah. Once I, too, am gone, these flowers shall pass on to her.

732750108.text: Thank you, child. There is little I can give you... but please accept these fruits and flowers.
